blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Only four of the 15 food service contracts awarded by Davao City to a corporation linked to Vice President Sara Duterte went through public bidding, an official of the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) said on Monday. The rest, according to prosecution witness and PhilGEPS Electronic Government Procurement Operations Division chief Rendell Sopeña, were awarded to GenCorp Industries Inc. “through negotiated small-value procurement.” Duterte listed the company in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth although her name did not appear as part of GenCorp’s corporate documents. “Sa mga kontrata ng Davao City LGU na inaward sa […]...
